REFNO Synopsis: The MIA file says the AH-1G was hit by ground fire near the Laotian border and crashed; no survivors were seen.
War Story: The helicopter crashed in Laos, according to a witness statement given to the MIA board. A division operations log entry (TT 1201031016.pdf p27) records a Cobra down across the border, hit by ground fire.
